cases.expected: JsonNode located at '/properties/name' of the root schema (no ID stripping, pointer resolved)
cases.description: Schema has no ID (findSchemaResourceRoot().getId() returns null). The reference starts with '/' so it is decoded (no encoded chars) and resolved directly against the root schema node.

cases.expected: JsonNode located at '/properties/age' of the root schema (ID stripped, pointer resolved)
cases.description: Schema ID is 'http://example.com/schema'. The reference starts with this ID, therefore the ID part is stripped leaving '/properties/age'. The pointer is then resolved against the root schema node.

cases.expected: JsonNode located at '/definitions/person' of the root schema (fragment stripped, pointer resolved)
cases.description: Reference begins with '#/'. After optional ID stripping, the leading '#/' is removed (substring(1)) resulting in '/definitions/person', which is then resolved.

cases.expected: JsonNode located at '/definitions/address' of the root schema (ID stripped, fragment stripped, pointer resolved)
cases.description: Reference contains both an ID and a fragment. ID is stripped first, leaving '#/definitions/address'. The '#/' prefix is then removed, yielding '/definitions/address' which is resolved.

cases.expected: Root schema JsonNode (no pointer processing because it does not start with '/' after previous steps)
cases.description: After ID and '#/' handling, the resulting jsonPointer does not start with '/' so the method returns the original root schema node unchanged.

cases.expected: Result of handleNullNode(ref, schema) (the method is called because node.at('/nonexistent/path') returns MissingNode)
cases.description: The pointer resolves to a missing node; the method should call handleNullNode and return its result.

cases.expected: JsonNode located at '/properties/name' of the root schema (encoded '/' decoded before resolution)
cases.description: Reference contains an encoded '/' (%2F). After ID and fragment handling, the pointer starts with '/', the method decodes it using UTF‑8, turning it into '/properties/name' before resolution.
Passing a null reference should cause a NullPointerException because the method invokes ref.startsWith(...) without a null‑check.
An empty string does not trigger ID stripping, '#/' removal, or '/' handling, so the method should return the original root schema node unchanged.

cases.expected: Root schema JsonNode (ID stripped leaving empty pointer)
cases.description: When the reference exactly equals the schema ID, the ID part is stripped, leaving an empty jsonPointer. Because it does not start with '/', the method returns the root schema node.

group: Reference without leading slash after ID stripping

cases.expected: Root schema JsonNode (pointer does not start with '/' after ID stripping)
cases.description: The reference starts with the schema ID, which is stripped, leaving 'properties/name' (no leading '/'). The method therefore skips pointer resolution and returns the root node.

cases.expected: JsonNode located at '/properties name' of the root schema (plus decoded to space)
cases.description: The '+' character is decoded by URLDecoder into a space character. After decoding, the pointer becomes '/properties name' which is resolved against the root schema.

cases.expected: JsonNode located at '/properties name' of the root schema (encoded space decoded)
cases.description: The reference contains an encoded space (%20). The method decodes it to a literal space before resolving the pointer.

group: Fragment only reference without leading slash

cases.expected: Root schema JsonNode (fragment not prefixed with '#/', so no stripping; pointer does not start with '/', method returns root node)
cases.description: A fragment that starts with '#', but not with '#/', bypasses the '#/' removal logic. Since the resulting jsonPointer does not begin with '/', the method returns the root schema node unchanged.

group: Encoded slash after ID stripping leading to missing node

cases.expected: Result of handleNullNode(ref, schema) (decoded pointer '/nonexistent/path' resolves to MissingNode, triggering handleNullNode)
cases.description: ID is stripped, leaving '#/nonexistent%2Fpath'. After '#/' removal, jsonPointer becomes '/nonexistent%2Fpath', which is decoded to '/nonexistent/path'. The node is missing, so handleNullNode should be invoked.
When findSchemaResourceRoot() returns null, the subsequent call to schema.getId() triggers a NullPointerException before any other processing.

findSchemaResourceRoot() returns a valid JsonSchema, but its getSchemaNode() returns null. Because the ref starts with '/', the method attempts node.at(jsonPointer) on a null node, causing a NullPointerException.
